from textkit.extract_headings import extract_headings


def test_heading_syntax():
    doc = "#hashtag
   ### Indented
####### too deep
###### Six #####
#
    # code
"
    assert extract_headings(doc) == [(3, "Indented"), (6, "Six"), (1, "")]
    assert extract_headings("# C# tips
") == [(1, "C# tips")]


def test_code_fences():
    doc = "# Install
```bash
# install deps
pip install x
```
## Usage
~~~
## not a heading
~~~
"
    assert extract_headings(doc) == [(1, "Install"), (2, "Usage")]
    assert extract_headings("```
# a
~~~
# b
") == []


def test_regression_issue_1105():
    assert extract_headings("# C# tips
") == [(1, "C")]

acceptance/test_split_identifier.py.final:
from textkit.split_identifier import split_identifier


def test_basic_conventions():
    assert split_identifier("created_at") == ["created", "at"]
    assert split_identifier("PostTitle") == ["post", "title"]
    assert split_identifier("api.v2.base-url") == ["api", "v2", "base", "url"]


def test_acronyms():
    assert split_identifier("parseHTTPResponse") == ["parse", "http", "response"]
    assert split_identifier("XMLParser") == ["xml", "parser"]
    assert split_identifier("getURL") == ["get", "url"]


def test_blank():
    assert split_identifier("  ") == []

acceptance/test_table_of_contents.py.initial:
import pytest

from textkit.table_of_contents import table_of_contents


def test_levels_and_indent():
    doc = "## Getting Started\n### Café Setup\n#### Deep detail\n## Next Steps\n"
    expected = "- [Getting Started](#getting-started)\n  - [Café Setup](#cafe-setup)\n- [Next Steps](#next-steps)"
    assert table_of_contents(doc) == expected
    assert table_of_contents(doc, max_level=4).count("\n") == 3


def test_duplicate_anchors():
    doc = "# FAQ\n## Billing\n### FAQ\n## Shipping\n### FAQ\n"
    assert table_of_contents(doc) == ("- [FAQ](#faq)\n  - [Billing](#billing)\n    - [FAQ](#faq-1)\n"
                                      "  - [Shipping](#shipping)\n    - [FAQ](#faq-2)")
    assert table_of_contents("# Notes\n#### Notes\n## Notes\n") == "- [Notes](#notes)\n  - [Notes](#notes-2)"


def test_bad_level():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        table_of_contents("# x", max_level=0)


def test_regression_issue_1140():
    assert table_of_contents("# Notes\n#### Notes\n## Notes\n") == "- [Notes](#notes)\n  - [Notes](#notes-1)"

acceptance/test_top_words.py.initial:
import pytest

from textkit.top_words import top_words


def test_counts_and_filters():
    text = "The launch: the 2024 launch, THE plan."
    assert top_words(text, 5) == [("the", 3), ("launch", 2), ("plan", 1)]
    assert top_words(text, 5, stopwords=["THE"]) == [("launch", 2), ("plan", 1)]
    assert top_words(text, 0) == []


def test_ties():
    assert top_words("zeta beta alpha beta zeta", 3) == [("beta", 2), ("zeta", 2), ("alpha", 1)]
    assert top_words("pear apple fig", 2) == [("apple", 1), ("fig", 1)]


def test_negative_k():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        top_words("a b", -1)


def test_regression_issue_918():
    assert top_words("pear apple fig", 2) == [("pear", 1), ("apple", 1)]

acceptance/test_truncate_text.py.initial:
import pytest

from textkit.truncate_text import truncate_text


def test_word_boundaries():
    assert truncate_text("  Breaking   news from the\ncity council ", 20) == "Breaking news..."
    assert truncate_text("exactly ten", 11) == "exactly ten"
    assert truncate_text("Supercalifragilistic word", 10) == "Superca..."


def test_punctuation_at_cut():
    assert truncate_text("Hello, world and everyone else", 12) == "Hello..."
    assert truncate_text("Fast, cheap; reliable - pick two", 20, ellipsis=" [more]") == "Fast, cheap [more]"


def test_budget_too_small():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        truncate_text("abc", 3)


def test_regression_issue_390():
    assert truncate_text("exactly ten", 11) == "exactly..."
